title: Houston dealbreakers, ranked.
old_caption:
Worried your dealbreakers make you too picky?
Knowing them isn't picky, it's honest. Say them up front and know your no.

title: The great city debate.
old_caption:
Atlanta or Miami? Aries and Sagittarius cannot agree.
Libra stays neutral, because the last word belongs to you.

title: Houston is full of people.
old_caption:
Tired of scrolling forever and meeting nobody?
The stars say skip the endless feed. One small hand a night is plenty.

title: Road trip: El Paso
old_caption:
What does it mean to really show up for someone?
The road-trip stars meet a star on a mountain that just stays lit, every night. Be that steady.

title: Saturn's class: the final exam.
old_caption:
Can you say what you actually want in a partner?
In Saturn's class, the only wrong answers are vague ones. Specific is attractive.

title: LAP 1 · LAST TIME: 9
old_caption:
Feel like your relationship keeps going in circles?
Gemini and Sagittarius finally take the exit, and head somewhere that's theirs.

title: The 5th house is the fun floor.
old_caption:
Does your date feel more like a job interview?
The 5th house is about romance and play. Less interview, more party.

title: Houston, we have a match.
old_caption:
A hundred episodes, one finished constellation.
Every couple, the Aunties, even the shy ghost, together for the finale. Where should the stars go next?

title: Leo and Aquarius: the first date.
old_caption:
First date where you couldn't stop talking about yourself?
Leo catches it mid-story and asks one question. Learning looks good on you.

title: Road trip: Fort Worth
old_caption:
Taurus, ever been stubborn over the last snack?
In Fort Worth, Taurus learns loyalty is big and sharing the small stuff is easy.
